title: Confirm — Request
description: A relying party asks a wallet (or other approval agent) to obtain user confirmation for an action. The wallet surfaces the reason to the user and returns a signed confirm/response.

subject.description: The VID whose consent the relying party is asking for. The wallet MUST verify it speaks for this VID.

challenge.description: base64url-encoded nonce ≥128 bits. Echoed and signed in the confirm-response.

reason.description: Human-readable action description shown to the user verbatim. SHOULD be specific ("Confirm transfer of $100 to bob.example" — not "Approve action").

actionType.description: Optional machine-readable action category the wallet MAY use for UI styling, history grouping, or local policy. Free-form; ecosystems define the vocabulary (e.g. "payment.transfer", "acl.delete", "data.share").

actionDetails.description: Optional structured payload describing the action — amount, beneficiary, scope, etc. The wallet MAY surface fields to the user. Framework imposes no schema; consumer-defined.

ttl.description: Seconds within which the relying party expects a response. The wallet SHOULD treat as advisory.

Response.title: Confirm Request — synchronous ack
Response.description: Synchronous acknowledgement that the wallet received the request and will (or will not) deliver a confirm/response. The actual signed confirmation arrives via confirm/response out-of-band. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/confirm/request/0.1#response.
